scam.label: Scam or fraud
scam.explanation: Your account was used in a way that looks like a scam, such as fake offers or attempts to take money from other users.

fake_listings.label: Fake or misleading listings
fake_listings.explanation: Your listings show properties, photos or prices that are not real or do not match the actual place.

asked_money_upfront.label: Asking for money before a viewing
asked_money_upfront.explanation: Users reported that you asked for a deposit or payment before they could see the property. This is not allowed on our site.

spam.label: Spam
spam.explanation: Your account posted repeated, irrelevant or promotional content.

abusive_behavior.label: Abusive behavior
abusive_behavior.explanation: Users reported rude, threatening or harassing messages from your account.

impersonation.label: Pretending to be someone else
impersonation.explanation: Your account uses a name, photo or business details that belong to another person or company.

discrimination.label: Discrimination
discrimination.explanation: Your listings or messages limit who may rent or buy. Every person must be treated equally.

turned_away.label: Turning guests away
turned_away.explanation: A guest told us that because of who they are, their booking was cancelled, they were refused, or they were asked about their religion or origin. Every host on our site promises to welcome Israeli and Jewish guests.

multiple_accounts.label: Several accounts
multiple_accounts.explanation: You use more than one account in a way that breaks our rules, for example to get around a limit or a block.

rules_violation.label: Breaking the site rules
rules_violation.explanation: Your account broke the rules of our site. Please read them again carefully.

other.label: Other
other.explanation: Please read the note from our team below.

document_unreadable.label: The document can't be read
document_unreadable.explanation: The photo or scan is blurry, too dark or cut off. Please send a clear photo where every detail can be read.

document_expired.label: The document has expired
document_expired.explanation: The document you sent is no longer valid. Please send a valid document.

document_incomplete.label: Something is missing
document_incomplete.explanation: Some pages or sides of the document are missing. Please send the complete document.

wrong_document.label: Wrong type of document
wrong_document.explanation: This document can't be used for this check. Please read the instructions and send the requested document.

name_mismatch.label: The name doesn't match
name_mismatch.explanation: The name on the document is different from the name on your account. Please update your account name or send a document in your name.

selfie_mismatch.label: The selfie doesn't match
selfie_mismatch.explanation: We couldn't match your selfie with the photo on the document. Please take a new, well-lit selfie holding the document.

cadastral_mismatch.label: The cadastral code doesn't match
cadastral_mismatch.explanation: The cadastral code on the extract is different from the one on your listing. Please check both and send the correct extract.

suspected_forgery.label: The document couldn't be confirmed
suspected_forgery.explanation: We couldn't confirm that this document is genuine. Please contact support if you think this is a mistake.

other.label: Other
other.explanation: Please read the note from our team below.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Full backup and data clean-ups. Every action is written to the audit log.

backup.title: Full backup
backup.lead: Saves every table of the database to the backups folder on the server, as one consistent snapshot. It can be restored into an empty database.
backup.fresh: There is a backup from the last hour, so clean-ups can run.
backup.stale: A clean-up can run only after a full backup from the last hour.
backup.hostNote: On hosting without a permanent disk (like Vercel) backups can't be kept here. Use the database host's backups there.

cleanups.title: Data clean-ups
cleanups.lead: First a check, which changes nothing, then the run. A run needs a full backup from the last hour, and running it again is safe.
cleanups.runDescription: {count, plural, one {1 change will be made} other {{countText} changes will be made}}. It is written to the audit log and can be restored from the {time} backup.
cleanups.filesWarning: The files themselves can't be restored from the backup: it holds the database only.
cleanups.needsBackup: Needs a backup from the last hour

phones.title: Phone numbers in international format
phones.lead: <ltr>+972 53…</ltr> and <ltr>+995 5…</ltr>, without the 0 after the country code. A number without a country code is not changed, and a number that would clash with another account is never merged.

titleEmoji.title: Emojis out of titles
titleEmoji.lead: Removes emojis from listing titles and their translations, and refreshes search. Descriptions are not changed.

contactTaps.title: Contact taps without who tapped
contactTaps.lead: Keeps only the channel and the time. Hosts' stats don't change.

verificationFiles.title: Delete ID and selfie files
verificationFiles.lead: Deletes the stored verification files: IDs, selfies and ownership papers. The decisions stay, marked “documents deleted”.

flags.description: Hosts who cancelled within 48 hours, guests who didn't come, long stays, guests who cancel again and again, and hosts with {min} or more reports.

viewHints.cancellations: The host cancelled within 48 hours of the booking, or the guest wrote that the host asked them to cancel. While the flag is open, the host's new listings wait for review.

viewHints.longStays: Bookings of {nights} nights or more that haven't ended yet: one booking can block a host's calendar for weeks. For review only; the booking stays.
viewHints.guests: Guests with {cancel} or more cancellations in the last 90 days, or {noShow} or more no-show reports in the last 12 months. For review only: nobody is blocked or told. A cancellation because the flight was cancelled doesn't count. A new cancellation or no-show opens the flag again.
viewHints.hosts: Hosts with {min} or more reports in the last 12 months, dismissed ones left out. A new report opens the flag again.

unreachableReasons.email_failing: The host's email is paused after a bounce

flagExplain.no_show: The host says the guest didn't come. For information only.

referencePrices.title: Reference prices
referencePrices.description: Price ranges from public reports, for the hosts' price guide. Only a range, a source and a month, never copied listings.
referencePrices.emptyHint: Add a range from a public report, with the source's name and the report's month.
referencePrices.newDescription: Copy a range from a public report. The price guide shows it with its source and month.

active.deactivateDescription: The range for {label} will no longer show in the price guide. You can turn it back on at any time.
active.reactivateDescription: The range for {label} will show in the price guide again.

form.publicOnly: Public reports only: copy the range (from–to), the source's name and the report's month. Never make up numbers or copy listings.
form.neighborhoodHint: Optional. Without a neighborhood the range fits the whole city.
form.perSqmHint: The report gives a price per square meter, not a full price.
form.sourceMonthHint: The month the report describes, e.g. 2026-10.
form.sourceUrlHint: Optional but recommended, so it can be checked.
form.preview: How it will look in the guide
form.previewEmpty: Fill in the range, the source and the month to see a preview.

badges.title: We visited
badges.description: The “We visited” badge tells guests that someone from the Bayit team visited the place in person. It shows on the listing page with the month of the visit, as a tag on cards and as a search filter.
badges.rules: Only an admin adds or removes the badge, with the visit date and an internal note saying who visited. The note stays in the admin panel and never shows on the site. Demo listings never get the badge. The badge doesn't expire and stays when the host edits the listing; this page marks listings whose address, pin or most photos changed since the visit.
badges.adminOnly: Only an admin can add or remove the badge. You can view the list.
